title: One issue
story: I work in the kitchen of a restaurant in Texas. I have been working about 55 hours every week since March, but my paychecks only show 40 hours. I keep my own list of the hours I work. When I asked my manager about the missing pay, he said overtime is not paid here. I still work there.

title: Several issues
story: Last month my husband shoved me against a wall during an argument, and I am scared he will do it again. I took our two kids to my sister's house in Pennsylvania. I want to file for divorce and I need custody of the children. Because I missed four shifts while we were moving, my manager at the warehouse fired me on Friday and has not paid me for my last two weeks of work.

title: The skeptic steps in
story: I run a small bakery by myself. In May a customer slipped on a wet spot near the counter and broke her wrist. Yesterday a man handed me papers saying she is suing the bakery, and I have to answer within 20 days. My landlord also says I must pay for the broken floor tiles before he renews the lease for the shop. I do not know where to start.
